newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 7.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan cabinet may be reshuffled partially following public outcry over murder of famous actress's daughter.
Japanese legislator lands on disputed East China Sea island, plants Japanese flag.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan establishes diplomatic ties with Sao Tome.
Opposition legislators demand resignation of Premier Lien Chan to take responsibility for murder of actress Pai Ping-ping's daughter.
LIBERTY TIMES - Parliament passes bill allowing more frequent promotions for police officers.
Some 75 percent of Taiwan people think social order is worsening.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Central bank will not adjust reserve requirements.
Pressure mounts for reshuffle of cabinet.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Wall Street hits new high.
